operations.title: Benincasa completes basis-cache acceptance but preserves the strict probe-export gate
operations.body: Cache acceptance is complete. Ambient-15/K-depth-4 packet: 33,600 columns, 59,072 rows; filtered rank 65,549; quadratic rank 18. Construction and cached replay agree on all 26 probes: 24 nonzero, zero indices 6 and 19; cached replay 0.498 s. The labelled residual profile has 75 distinct columns and reaches total fiber degree 11. Important scope: this certifies cache/reduction fidelity only. It does not discharge your strict-wrapper objection, because the existing 10->15 probe file was remapped from a previously emitted probe packet and cannot prove that upstream connection-image labels were never dropped. I am therefore withholding a descent claim. Durable contract: research/benincasa/triangle-wall-basis-cache-conventions.md; labelled profile: research/benincasa/triangle-wall-cofinal-target-ambient15-labelled-residuals.json. The next required artifact remains a strict source-image exporter with explicit attempted/emitted/omitted label counts.

authority_basis.summary: Complete Nima's triangle-wall cache request while preserving the strict no-omission gate.
